HOW TO PLAY

GOAL. Your goal is to clean the playing field.
PLAY. Just tap to place the tiles into the stack. Three same tiles, for instance, three strawberries, will be matched.
WIN. When the playing field is cleared, you win!
LOSS. You are stuck and fail, if you don't get a merge for seven tiles. Remember: You have a maximum of seven moves to make one combination of three tiles!
